faqs.question: What does DotGrey actually do?
faqs.answer: Design and build digital products. In practice that means UI/UX design, web development, email templates, banner ads, Veeva content and motion — usually two or three of those together on the same engagement.

faqs.question: Who do you usually work with?
faqs.answer: Funded startups and established teams rebuilding something that has outgrown its original design. Company sizes run from five people to a few hundred. We are happy to say no when a project is not a fit.

faqs.question: Where is the team based?
faqs.answer: Our studio is in Dhaka and part of the team is remote across four time zones. We overlap comfortably with European and Gulf hours, and keep at least four hours of overlap with North American clients.

faqs.question: Do you sign NDAs?
faqs.answer: Yes, routinely, and before the first detailed conversation if you prefer. We can work from your template or send ours.

faqs.question: How does a project start?
faqs.answer: A short call, then a written brief we both agree on before any work begins. For most engagements we also run a kickoff workshop in the first week to settle scope and success measures.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: An email template set runs one to two weeks. A marketing site is four to six. A product design engagement is usually eight to twelve. You get a dated plan before anything starts, and we flag slippage the week it happens rather than at the end.

faqs.question: How involved do I need to be?
faqs.answer: One workshop at the start, a weekly review of about forty-five minutes, and prompt answers to unblocking questions. Beyond that, as involved as you want to be.

faqs.question: What do you need from me to get started?
faqs.answer: A signed proposal, one decision-maker who can approve work, and access to whatever already exists — brand files, analytics, the current site. If some of that is missing we will work around it.

faqs.question: Are the free first deliverables really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. One email template, one UI/UX screen or one small development task, with no obligation and no card required. It is how we would rather introduce ourselves than with a deck.

faqs.question: Do you charge for revisions?
faqs.answer: Starter includes two revisions per request. Growth and Scale include unlimited revisions within the agreed scope. Changing the scope itself is a separate conversation, and we tell you before the meter starts.

faqs.question: Can I pause or cancel a retainer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Retainers are monthly with no minimum term. Pause or cancel with fourteen days' notice and you keep everything produced up to that point.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Bank transfer and card. Fixed-scope projects are billed 50% at kickoff and 50% at handover. Retainers are billed monthly in advance.

faqs.question: Do you maintain things after launch?
faqs.answer: Every build includes thirty days of post-launch support. After that you can move to a maintenance retainer or take the codebase in-house — it is documented either way, and there is no lock-in.

faqs.question: Can I outsource white-label work to you?
faqs.answer: Yes. A reasonable share of our work is white-label for other agencies. We stay invisible, work in your tools, and sign whatever you need us to sign.
